title: P0.23: External Consultation Intent Robustness + Security Verification Handoff + UI Stall Closure Guard
description: Three critical runtime issues: (1) ChatGPT variant spellings ('chat gpt', 'chat-gpt', 'chatgo') and imperative action patterns ('hazle a chatgpt', 'a chatgpt hazla') were not recognized as external consultation intents, falling through to local chat or operational_status. (2) browser_security_verification errors during ChatGPT consultation caused NoneType.get exceptions instead of structured handoff with clear user guidance. (3) _set_live_status('idle') after heavy local chat (>10s) emitted dataChanged synchronously, blocking the main thread for 36+ seconds.
reason: Intent detection in AssistantPreferenceResolver only matched exact canonical family names without alias normalization. _is_operational_status_question() did not exclude messages containing action verbs + assistant targets. Worker error handler did not intercept browser_security_verification errors. _apply_task_failure traced dispatch_terminal with empty dispatch_id. _set_live_status always emitted dataChanged synchronously regardless of preceding task weight.
next_action: Live proof on Windows with ChatGPT: user writes 'consulta nueva a ChatGPT: responde solo S si entiendes'. Must terminate in response_captured, blocked_by_security_verification with guidance, or blocked_by_resource_pressure with retry. Never local chat, operational_status, NoneType, empty dispatch_id, or UI stall >5s.
resume_hint: P0.23 code fix applied: AssistantPreferenceResolver normalizes 'chat gpt'/'chat-gpt' aliases, resolves 'chatgo' typo with action verb, matches imperative action patterns. _is_operational_status_question excludes action verb + assistant target combos. Worker catches browser_security_verification and emits structured blocked_by_security_verification result. _apply_task_failure preserves dispatch_id from _active_dispatch_ids. _set_live_status defers dataChanged.emit when _heavy_result_guard_active after chat >10s.

metadata.root_cause: Bug 1: AssistantPreferenceResolver.resolve() only checked canonical _ASSISTANT_FAMILIES names, missing 'chat gpt', 'chat-gpt', 'chatgo' variants. Bug 2: _is_operational_status_question() returned True for messages containing action verbs + ChatGPT target. Bug 3: Worker except handler emitted generic taskFailed for browser_security_verification instead of structured result. Bug 4: _apply_task_failure called _trace_dispatch_terminal without dispatch_id. Bug 5: _set_live_status always called dataChanged.emit() synchronously.

fixes_applied.task_b: AssistantPreferenceResolver: added _ASSISTANT_ALIASES for 'chat gpt'/'chat-gpt', _ASSISTANT_TYPO_ALIASES for 'chatgo' with action verb guard, _EXTERNAL_ACTION_VERBS for imperative patterns, _normalize_assistant_aliases() preprocessing, _resolve_typo_with_action() method, extended _CONSULT_TOKENS with 'consulta nueva', 'preguntale a', 'pidele a', 'hazle a'
fixes_applied.task_c: _is_operational_status_question() now returns False when message contains both an action verb and an assistant target from _EXTERNAL_ACTION_VERBS_FOR_EXCLUSION / _EXTERNAL_TARGETS_FOR_EXCLUSION
fixes_applied.task_d: Worker except handler detects browser_security_verification / NoneType.get and emits structured blocked_by_security_verification result via taskResolved instead of generic taskFailed
fixes_applied.task_f: _set_live_status defers dataChanged.emit to background thread when _heavy_result_guard_active; _apply_task_result activates guard when chat task exceeds _HEAVY_RESULT_THRESHOLD_S (10s); traces ui_status_emit_deferred and post_result_ui_update_coalesced
